trade: fisher on the shallows below the walls
spot: the open water south of Lilmoth's walls, among the lily pads
backstory: He fishes the shallows below Lilmoth's walls from the lily pads and sells his catch inside. He lives outside the walls because the rent inside is more than fish pay.

spot: the village on the marsh about 200 m south-west of Lilmoth Dock, by the food barrel
backstory: Flaa Heet leads a handful of families who live outside Lilmoth's walls on the open marsh south-west of the dock. They fish, gather leeks and keep their stores in barrels, and sell a little at two stalls. He has no seat on the merchant council and wants none; he keeps his people fed and out of the city's quarrels.

trade: a child of Flaa Heet's village
spot: the north side of Flaa Heet's village
backstory: A hatchling of the village. He runs errands to the barrels and watches the path to the dock for strangers.

trade: sells from a stall in Flaa Heet's village
spot: the north stall of Flaa Heet's village
backstory: She sells what the village does not eat to travellers on the path to the dock: food from the barrels and what the marsh gives.

spot: the west edge of the village, toward the barrel camp
backstory: She keeps the village's stores: she fills the barrels to the west with what the marsh gives, leeks and flowers from the slope to the east, and knows what is in each. She goes to Lilmoth Dock only when she must.

trade: sells from a stall in Flaa Heet's village
spot: the south stall of Flaa Heet's village
backstory: She keeps the south stall and haggles harder than her neighbour. She hears what travellers say and passes it on.

trade: a sellsword who fights with fists
spot: the shore track south-west of Lilmoth Dock, with two companions
backstory: He travels with a mage and a swordsman, taking work where the merchants of Lilmoth pay for guards. Just now they are between jobs.

trade: a mage for hire who casts fire
spot: the shore track south-west of Lilmoth Dock, with two companions
backstory: He is the one of the three who reads. He casts fire and keeps a ward up, and he chose Lilmoth for its Hist and its old Imperial ruins.

trade: a sellsword who fights with two blades
spot: the shore track south-west of Lilmoth Dock, with two companions
backstory: He fights with a blade in each hand and does the bargaining for the three of them.

trade: a drinker who has lost his work
spot: the shore between the dead trees, south-west of Lilmoth Dock
backstory: He unloaded the small boats at the dock until he drank his wages once too often. Now he sits by the dead trees and watches the dock he lost.

trade: a thief who works the road to the dock
spot: the leek beds south of Lilmoth Dock
backstory: He takes from travellers on the way to the dock and says he gathers leeks. He will tell a stranger anything but his business.

trade: a thief who works the road to the dock
spot: the leek beds south of Lilmoth Dock
backstory: He works with the other thief by the leeks. He knows where the dead lie and what they carry, and he has not yet gone to see.
